title: Schedule of Deposit and Occupancy Dates under the Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
The deposit, the balance and the occupancy date of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** follow the timetable below. The figures are identical under the LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan, the LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan, the LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan, the LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan, the LifeCare Declining Balance Plan and the LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan.

| Term | Value under each of the six plans |
|---|---|
| Deposit at signing | 10 percent of the entrance fee |
| Deposit held in escrow until occupancy or rescission | Yes |
| Balance received no later than | 7 calendar days before the occupancy date |
| Occupancy to take place within | 90 calendar days after signing |
| Length of one occupancy extension | 30 calendar days |
| Maximum occupancy extensions per agreement | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreement)

For a hypothetical entrance fee of 300000.00, the deposit at 10 percent is 30000.00 and the balance is 270000.00. Counting the signing date as day 0, occupancy falls due within 90 calendar days; a single extension moves the planned occupancy date 30 calendar days later.

## Points of reading

- The deposit percentage and the escrow arrangement are the same for every refund plan; only the entrance fee they apply to differs.
- One extension is the maximum under every plan; a second extension is not available.
